annotationStatus: Synthetic. Development cases: production QA declarations and one development author. Holdout: authored and judged by two separate agent instances blind to the engine and to each other's labels; not human judged.
rubric: kinds-rubric-v1: financial money; material tools, equipment, venues; living land and living things themselves, not information about them; intellectual knowledge, data, research, maps; experiential skills passed on by doing; social relationships, introductions, volunteers, fiscal hosts; cultural art, story, language, heritage; spiritual ceremony, care, listening. Explicitly denied kinds are excluded.

thresholds.source: 80% is the 20-case production floor recorded in docs/platform/prototype/proof/go-live-2026-11-16/quality-results.json; named regressions are the production sample, negation gate and soil finding.
